desc: Derive the counting formula: for each present middle value \(B\), add \((\operatorname{conv}[2B]-1)/2\), where the removed 1 is the self-pair \((B,B)\).
Determine that quadratic pair or distance enumeration is not viable at the maximum constraints.
Build the membership polynomial, compute the sum of valid coefficients for present middle values, and output the integer result.
Implement exact NTT convolution with a transform length chosen dynamically as the smallest power of two greater than \(2\max(S)\), and validate all samples.
Validate the supplied implementation against all public samples.
Establish correctness and complexity: the algorithm uses \(O(M\log M)\) time and \(O(M)\) memory, with \(M\) the next power of two above \(2\max(S)\).
